heading: Json traversal expressions
text:
### Json traversal expressions [LNLS.3.9]

Any expression of the form `<binding>["key"]` or `<binding>.key`
that traverses a `json`-typed value is a compile error.  This is a
consequence of LNLS.3.1 (no `json` slots); it is listed separately
because `json` values can arise from call responses.
